response.sql: WITH per_order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(fillcount) as overall_avg FROM orderexecutions), tier1 AS (SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - o.overall_avg as margin_vs_overall FROM per_order_avgs p CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE p.avg_fill > o.overall_avg), tier1_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as tier1_avg FROM tier1), tier2 AS (SELECT t.avg_fill, t.margin_vs_overall, t.avg_fill - ta.tier1_avg as margin_vs_tier1 FROM tier1 t CROSS JOIN tier1_avg ta WHERE t.avg_fill > ta.tier1_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) as avg_fill_final_orders, AVG(margin_vs_overall) as avg_margin_vs_benchmark1, AVG(margin_vs_tier1) as avg_margin_vs_benchmark2 FROM tier2;
